classification.difficultyReason: The hardest parts require separating nested figures, adding segments to obtain a whole corresponding side, then applying the scale factor. Redraw prompts and correspondence markings scaffold this routine chain.

content.prompt: Calculate the scale factor and then determine the unknown length.

spec.description: Nested OMN and PMQ retain collinear O, P, M and M, Q, N; the source distinguishes the nested and exposed sides by colour.
spec.mathematics: OM=8+16=24; PM corresponds to OM and PQ to ON.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Redraw $\triangle OMN$ and $\triangle PMQ$ separately. Corresponding vertices are $O\leftrightarrow P$, $M\leftrightarrow M$ and $N\leftrightarrow Q$.
$$\begin{aligned}OM&=8+16=24\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac{16}{24}=\frac23\\x&=18\times\frac23\\x&=12\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Separate corresponding triangles with completed relevant side labels.
Nested triangles retain the shared right vertex and consecutive 3 cm and 2 cm segments. The square is an angle-correspondence symbol, not a right-angle corner.
spec.mathematics: Whole sloping side is 5 cm; small corresponding sloping side is 2 cm; 4 cm corresponds to x.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Redraw the large and small triangles separately, matching the triangle, dot and square symbols.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Large sloping side}&=3+2=5\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac25=0.4\\x&=4\times0.4\\x&=1.6\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Separate triangles preserve all correspondence symbols and completed relevant lengths.
Nested upright rectangles share their lower-right corner. The right side retains its 5 cm and 3 cm segments.
spec.mathematics: Large height is 8 cm; small height is 3 cm; large width is 6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Redraw the rectangles separately with corresponding widths and heights.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Large height}&=5+3=8\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac38\\x&=6\times\frac38\\x&=2.25\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Separate similar rectangles show whole heights and corresponding widths.
Nested similar quadrilaterals retain the shared lower-right corner, split vertical measurement and matching square, dot and triangle symbols. Squares indicate correspondence, not right angles.
spec.mathematics: Large right side is 10 cm; small right side is 6 cm; 12 cm corresponds to x.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Redraw the quadrilaterals separately, matching the square, dot and triangle symbols.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Large right side}&=4+6=10\text{ cm}\\\text{Scale factor}&=\frac6{10}=0.6\\x&=12\times0.6\\x&=7.2\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
